articles.title: India slashes cost of cancer drugs after court rules mark-ups are ‘extortion’

events.summary: The Indian government has intervened to slash the prices of 137 cancer drugs following a Supreme Court case initiated by a retired bank clerk. The ruling addressed unaffordable mark-ups that drove patients into financial ruin.
events.why: Government price controls on dozens of critical oncology medications will alleviate severe healthcare costs for millions of patients.

articles.title: Magnitude-7 earthquake hits Tibet, killing at least 16 and destroying hundreds of homes

events.summary: A magnitude-7 earthquake struck the northern city of Nagqu in Tibet, killing at least 16 people, injuring 54, and destroying hundreds of homes. At least seven aftershocks were recorded as search and rescue operations commenced.
events.why: A strong earthquake caused significant loss of life, injury, and infrastructure destruction.

articles.title: Romania blames Russia for ship attack in the Black Sea

events.summary: Romania has accused Russia of carrying out a ship attack in the Black Sea. Russian strikes targeting vessels carrying Ukrainian cargo and grain through the western Black Sea have increased sharply this month.
events.why: Attacks on maritime trade in the Black Sea threaten global food supplies and risk drawing NATO member states into broader conflict.

articles.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says

events.summary: One person was killed and five wounded in a series of attacks near Paris, which French President Emmanuel Macron described as a racist terrorist attack. The suspected gunman has been apprehended.
events.why: Fatal racially motivated attacks impact public safety and indicate severe social tensions.

articles.title: Opposition deepfake video sparks outrage in Spain ahead of election

events.summary: A political campaign ad by Spain's main opposition party featured AI deepfakes of figures linked to the Prime Minister's party confessing to wrongdoing. The video sparked widespread outrage and ignited an intense national debate on generative AI ahead of the election.
events.why: The deployment of deceptive deepfakes in major elections poses significant risks to democratic integrity and spurs regulatory debate.

articles.title: Denmark to ban mink farming in government U-turn

events.summary: Denmark plans to ban mink farming in a policy reversal by the government. The country was formerly the world's largest producer of mink pelts before the industry declined.
events.why: The decision permanently shuts down a historically major agricultural sector in Denmark.

articles.title: Bulgaria: Concerns about security in the Black Sea dominate presidential election campaign

events.summary: Bulgaria's presidential election campaign is being heavily influenced by recent Black Sea ship drone attacks and reduced government support for Ukraine. Foreign policy has consequently emerged as a primary issue in the first round of voting.
events.why: Regional maritime conflict is actively reshaping election dynamics and defense policy in a NATO member country.
